partners.mechanism_chain: F7 (HGNC:3638) —DISRUPTS→ coagulation cascade (REACT:R-HSA-5690403); coagulation cascade (REACT:R-HSA-5690403) —LEADS_TO→ Factor VII deficiency (HP:0001895); AVP (HGNC:700) —DISRUPTS→ vasopressin signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70261); vasopressin signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70261) —LEADS_TO→ Neurohypophyseal diabetes insipidus (HP:0011292); F7 (HGNC:3638) —LEADS_TO→ Endoplasmic Reticulum-associated protein degradation (GO:0030438); AVP (HGNC:700) —LEADS_TO→ Endoplasmic Reticulum-associated protein degradation (GO:0030438).
